description: Lewis Carroll's Wonderland / Looking-Glass canon — a sub-world of literature, giving the concept-graph descent a third rung below literature.

microtheory.name: carroll
microtheory.definition: Lewis Carroll's nonsense canon: the characters and coinages of Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass, from the Cheshire Cat to the vorpal sword.

concepts.name: cheshire_cat
concepts.definition: Carroll's grinning, vanishing cat of Wonderland.

concepts.name: mad_hatter
concepts.definition: The Hatter of Carroll's mad tea-party.

concepts.name: white_rabbit
concepts.definition: The waistcoated rabbit Alice follows down the rabbit hole.

concepts.name: march_hare
concepts.definition: The Hatter's companion at the mad tea-party.

concepts.name: tweedledum
concepts.definition: One of the Looking-Glass twins, with Tweedledee.

concepts.name: tweedledee
concepts.definition: One of the Looking-Glass twins, with Tweedledum.

concepts.name: vorpal_sword
concepts.definition: The blade that slays the Jabberwock in Carroll's poem.

concepts.name: bandersnatch
concepts.definition: A fierce creature named in Jabberwocky and Snark.

concepts.name: jubjub_bird
concepts.definition: A desperate creature named in Jabberwocky.

concepts.name: slithy_toves
concepts.definition: Carroll's coined creatures from Jabberwocky's first line.

concepts.name: humpty_dumpty
concepts.definition: The egg who lectures Alice on the meaning of words in the Looking-Glass.

concepts.name: mock_turtle
concepts.definition: The melancholy creature of Wonderland's mock-turtle soup.
